title: The No.1 Ladies' Detective Agency
author: Alexander McCall Smith
summary: Precious Ramotswe opens Botswana's first female-run detective agency, using her wits and good sense. She takes on small cases of missing husbands, runaway daughters and fraud.
readIf: you like gentle, warm mysteries with a strong sense of place and kindly characters.
skipIf: you want intricate puzzles and high suspense.
